mechanism: Disulfiram may potentiate gentamicin's nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity through inhibition of aldehyde dehydrogenase and potential copper chelation effects that impair renal function.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and ototoxic signs closely; consider therapeutic drug monitoring of gentamicin levels and ensure adequate hydration; use only if benefits outweigh risks.
